text: This report submits the Toronto Zoo 2024 Operating Plan and Budget for approval. The Policy and Finance Committee reviewed the 2024 Operating Plan and Budget on 2023- 10-05 and recommended it for approval by the Board.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Approved the 2024 Operating Plan and Budget in Attachment 1 to the report (October 6, 2023) from the Director, Finance, Technology and Innovation, Toronto Zoo.
